extracted.name: Pecan Chicken Salad
extracted.description: This flavorful pecan chicken salad comes together fast using leftover or rotisserie chicken, herbs, celery, pecans, and a creamy homemade dressing.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 teaspoon Park Hill maple pepper (such as Savory Spice Shop®)
instruction_lines: Mix mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, vinegar, garlic powder, thyme, and maple pepper together in a bowl until well combined. Add chicken, celery, pecans, and red onion; stir well to incorporate.
Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 3 days.
